messages:
Incident Bot: PAGER: [INC-2026-04-21] us-east inference backend errors >6% (5m). Auto-escalation to oncall. Link: https://redwood.ops/inc/INC-2026-04-21
Tim (oncall): ack, taking. grabbing logs and distro.
Tim (oncall): quick summary: elevated 502s across inference-proxy clusters in us-east, provider-alpha reporting degraded nodes. Queue depth up, tail-latency spiking.
Sara W: seeing identical alarms in console - token rejection rates up for embeddings and generation routes.
Miguel R: any customer-facing impact? metrics show some 429s for heavy-concurrency customers.
Liz - CS: one customer (AcmeHR) reported increased latencies, they said 10-15% of calls failing. CC'd support.
Tim (oncall): triage notes - provider-alpha node drop started ~2087654200. Traffic still in region but backend capacity reduced.
Tim (oncall): mitigation plan proposal: 1) apply soft quota to free-tier routes in us-east; 2) partial brownout of expensive models in-region; 3) reroute a portion of region traffic to provider-beta and to us-west for more headroom.
Jia L: +1. prioritize keeping SLOs for paid customers. Suggest ramp: 40% reroute to provider-beta for all traffic, additional 30% to us-west for paid-only.
Alex P: can we do provider swap without full cutover? prefer staged: start with 20% to provider-beta, monitor errors then increase.
Tim (oncall): agree staged. I'll run traffic-shape command to start 20% reroute and enable quotas.
Tim (oncall): running: `rwctl traffic:set --region us-east --target provider-beta --pct 20 --mode staged --reason "INC-2026-04-21 provider-alpha degraded"`
OpsBot: executed: `traffic:set` job 7765 queued. ETA 30s.
OpsBot: job 7765 completed - 20% of routed inference traffic shifted to provider-beta in us-east.
Miguel R: monitoring traces - provider-beta shows normal response latencies so far. error rate on remaining provider-alpha dropped from 6.3% -> 5.2%.
Tim (oncall): next: soft-rate-limit free-tier routes in us-east to reduce load. command: `rwctl quota:update --region us-east --route "free/*" --rps 5`
OpsBot: quota:update applied to free routes in us-east.
Liz - CS: notifying affected trial customers via status page message. Draft: "We are mitigating degraded performance in us-east; you may see intermittent failures; prioritized paid traffic preserved."
Tim (oncall): next mitigation for expensive compute: partial brownout of high-cost model `redwood-gemini-xl-8k` in us-east. We'll disable that model variant for non-enterprise customers only.
Alex P: how do we toggle?
Tim (oncall): `rwctl model:disable --region us-east --model redwood-gemini-xl-8k --scope non-enterprise --reason "reduce load during provider degradation"`
OpsBot: model:disable request accepted, rollout started (canary 10% -> 100% in 2m).
Roger I: routing note - will need to ensure KV-cache warmers on provider-beta to avoid cold-start spike. scheduling a cache-warm job now.
Roger I: running: `infra-job run cache-warm --target provider-beta --region us-east --models redwood-*`
Miguel R: after 15m monitoring: overall 5xxs down to 1.1%, tail latency improving. provider-alpha still flaky at 3% error but stable.
Tim (oncall): good. increase staged reroute to 40% to provider-beta and concurrently start 30% cross-region to us-west for paid customers.
Tim (oncall): `rwctl traffic:set --region us-east --to provider-beta --pct 40`
OpsBot: executed job 7766 - provider-beta now receiving 40% of us-east traffic.
Tim (oncall): `rwctl traffic:set --region us-east --to region:us-west --pct 30 --customer-tier paid`
OpsBot: executed job 7767 - routed 30% of paid traffic to us-west.
Jia L: I'll inherit the oncall. Tim, want to handoff?
Tim (oncall): handing off now to Jia. summary: initial 20% reroute then scaled to 40% provider-beta; free-tier rate limits applied; brownout for redwood-gemini-xl-8k for non-enterprise; cache warmers running; customer impact reduced to a small subset of free trials.
Tim (oncall): open action items: monitor provider-alpha health, validate cache hit rates on provider-beta, CS updates for impacted customers. I'll stay available for context.
Jia L: ack takeover. continuing monitor and will escalate if errors creep above 2%.
Liz - CS: status page posted. sent direct note to AcmeHR asking to confirm whether issues persist.
Miguel R: recommend creating a follow-up runbook entry for staged provider failovers and brownouts — some steps we did were ad-hoc.
Tim (oncall): agreed, will draft runbook notes and link to ticket INC-2026-04-21-ARTIFACTS.
Incident Bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations in place. Current 5xx rate in us-east 0.9% (down from 6.3%). Monitoring window continue 30m.
Jia L: marking this thread as active handoff. I'll update last_message_ts when we declare resolved.
OpsBot: metrics snapshot: `errors 0.9% | avg-latency 210ms | queue-depth 12`
Jia L: continuing monitoring. if stable for 30m, plan to gradually roll traffic back and re-enable brownout models for non-enterprise.
Tim (oncall): final note to next rotation: keep the staged approach. avoid full immediate cutovers; prefer incremental 10-20% steps.
Jia L: noted. handing off to next oncall at 21:45 UTC.
Incident Bot: NOTE: page cleared for oncall handoff. Keep updates in this thread.
__meta: generated for dataset: incident thread representing region failover and traffic shaping coordination
